rules: Part 1 freezes prompt, schemas, decoding, model hashes, benchmark, scoring, winner rule, and lifecycle before any candidate output is exposed.
Part 2 uses only the development set for comparison under the frozen protocol.
The final acceptance set is opened exactly once in Part 3 under a lifecycle ledger entry bound to all relevant hashes.
No tuning against the final set. Any rerun requires review and a new ledger entry.
Phase 4 v3 artifacts remain immutable and are consumed read-only.
